summary: Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed (auth, profile, settings, salary, transactions CRUD, delete-lock, delete-account+reseed). Frontend: End-to-end UI flow validated on mobile viewport (390x844) — token injection via localStorage 'sm_session_token' works; Home dashboard, Salary sheet, Activity CRUD, Settings (accent, currency, name edit), Delete-account lock flow all functional.

issues: Save button lies just below/at edge of the mobile viewport on 390x844; Playwright reported 'element outside of viewport' when using .click() with force=False. Real users tapping will work but scroll may be desirable inside sheet. Worked via dispatch_event.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. (non-blocking, RN Web deprecation notice.)

action_items: Consider making bottom sheets scrollable / ensure Save buttons remain visible on smaller viewports (SalarySheet, TransactionSheet, Name/Delete sheets). Minor UX only.
Optional: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id in all queries (uses projection {_id:0}). Good.
401 (not 403) returned for auth failures as required. Good.
delete_account cleans transactions + sessions + user atomically-ish. Acceptable.
settings PUT accepts only theme/accent/currency and ignores None — correct partial update semantics.
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/seed_test_user.py after the delete-account test to restore user_testseed001. Restored theme=light, accent=navy, currency=EUR, name='Test User', delete_lock_until=null on the seed user after UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: inject localStorage['sm_session_token']=JSON.stringify('test_session_token_fixed_123456'), then reload — Home renders. Salary/Transaction/Delete sheets have Save buttons near viewport bottom; if playwright reports 'outside viewport' use page.dispatch_event(selector, 'click') instead of page.click(force=True). React Native Switch (data-testid='dark-mode-switch') does not respond to dispatch_event('click'); use real .click() with scroll or programmatic PUT /api/user/settings to toggle theme in tests.
rca_of_issue: No app bugs. Only tooling caveat: bottom-sheet Save buttons sit just at/below the fold on 390x844; Playwright click() throws 'element outside viewport'. Mitigation: dispatch_event('click', ...) works. For real users this is fine but ensuring content is fully in view is a minor UX polish item.
